name: To The Pointe Summer Dance
description_short: Weekly themed dance camps at To The Pointe Dance Studios in Cranston, RI, for ages 3 and up, grouped by age and taught by studio dance teachers. Campers learn routines (hip hop, jazz, ballet, pom), make themed crafts and perform a showcase for families on Friday. Half day 9am-12pm or full day 9am-3pm; no experience needed.

sources.note: 2026 Summer Camp Themes page: drop-off 9am, half day to 12pm (pack snacks), full day to 3pm (pack snacks and lunch); per camp 1 half day $49, 1 full day $69, 5 half days $229, 5 full days $299, plus a $15 registration fee in the cart; Wicked camp $214.
'MAIN OFFICE/FLAGSHIP STUDIO: 800 Oaklawn Ave Cranston RI 02920' (the studio moved there).

source.title: SUMMER DANCE | Discover, Dance, Excel - Join Today! — To The Pointe Dance Studios
